title: Unit 26 Consolidation: Media Ownership and Regulation, 2010–2026
grammar: Review: reporting, concession, verbal nouns, participles and contrast
goal: I can summarise the media laws, the ownership changes and the Index case between 2010 and 2026, with years and sources.
I can report, concede, name an action with a noun and contrast views on these events.
I can report the Sovereignty Protection Office, the European procedures and the 2026 election with dates.
